title: This Arcade Takes MEMORIES, Not Coins 🕹️
description:
My name is on every high score in this arcade, and I've never played a game here. My big sister wants the giant bear on the top shelf for her birthday, and the man at the prize counter just said "welcome back."

Every game here has a price, and it gets paid at the door on your way out.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment BEAR if you'd still play.
